Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The umpires and players make their way out to the middle. Ryan Rickelton and Tony de Zorzi will open the innings for South Africa. Alzarri Joseph will start with the new ball for West Indies. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, West Indies batters have failed to bat the full quota of 50 overs but they have given their bowlers something to bowl at. On the other hand, South Africa will be pleased with their bowling effort and the onus is now on their batters to take them past the finishing line. Will Aiden Markram and co. succeed in doing so? We shall find out shortly. Back in a bit for the chase...

After West Indies were put into bat, Kyle Mayers and Brandon King got the visitors off to a swift start. They did lose Mayers in the 7th over but Shamarh Brooks joined hands with Brandon King and kept the scoreboard ticking. The duo stitched a 71-run stand and by doing so, set a solid foundation. However, they were pegged back losing both set batters in quick succession. Moreover, the early departure of Shai Hope made matters worse for them. Nicholas Pooran got off to a start but could go on to get a big score. Jason Holder was holding his end but he too perished in his quest up to the ante. With 9 wickets down, Odean Smith struck a few meaty blows but his departure brought an end to the innings.

This has been a stunning bowling display by South Africa, bowling West Indies out inside the 50 overs. Considering the overhead conditions at the start of the game, the stand-in skipper of South Africa, Aiden Markram needed his new ball bowlers to get some early inroads. Marco Jansen did manage to take an early scalp but the rest of the bowlers were unable to compliment him. Once the first Powerplay was over, the hosts pulled things back with some quiet overs. They kept the pressure on the opposition batters and were rewarded with wickets at regular intervals. By doing so, they never allowed West Indies to gain any momentum in their innings. The lower-order batters did trouble them but it was a good cleanup job by the pacers. Marco Jansen, Bjorn Fortuin and Gerald Coetzee broke the back of the West Indies batting unit by accounting for two wickets each.
OUT! TIMBER! On a length and on off, Odean Smith looks to loft it but gets beaten the ball hits the top of off. Odean Smith's cameo comes to an end and West Indies and bundled out for 260 runs!
FOUR! Fine shot. Full and outside off, Smith smashes it through mid-wicket as the ball races away from the fence like a rocket.
Lands it on off, Joseph blocks it to mid off.
Wayne Parnell (5-1-26-0) comes back on.
Wide! Lands it down leg, Joseph misses his flick.
Shorter and on off, Smith pulls it but mistimes it completely. It goes up and lands safely at square leg. They cross.
A low full toss, on off, Smith looks to heave it but doesn't connect well as the ball rolls back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Smith goes for a wild swing and gets an outside edge as the ball races away from the third man fence.
Short and on off, Smith looks to pull it but misses.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Errs his line and bowls it on leg, Smith picks it well and helps it through backward square leg for a boundary!
Bangs a bouncer, on middle, Joseph ducks underneath it.
Slightly shorter one, Smith pulls it to square leg for one.
Short and outside off, Smith looks to pull it but misses.
Short and on off, Smith fends it back towards the bowler.
Good length, on off, Joseph taps it to covers for one.
Alzarri Joseph is the last man in.

OUT! TAKEN! On a length and some extra bounce, Hosein looks to flick it but gets the toe end of his bat. It goes high up in the air towards deep backward square leg. Lungi Ngidi settles under it and completes the catch.

Marco Jansen (7-0-27-2) comes back into the attack.
On middle, blocked out solidly.
Bowls it on off, Hosein flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on off, Smith pulls it to deep backward square leg for one.
Lands it down leg, Smith misses his flick and gets rapped on his pads. A stifled appeal but turned down.
FIVE WIDES! Bowls it way outside leg, Smith let's it be. The keeper fails to reach it as the ball races away from the fine leg fence.
Some extra bounce, on off, Smith fends it to covers.
Lands it on off, Hosein cuts it to covers for a single.
Quicker one, on middle, Smith blocks it back towards the bowler.
Lands it on off, Hosein flicks it to mid-wicket for one.

Bowls it outside off, Hosein cuts it to the man at point.
Another one on off, Hosein offers a dead bat to it.
On off, defended out.
Bowls it on off, Hosein moves forward to loft it but misses. The keeper fails to collect it as the stumping chance goes abegging.
Flighted up, on off, Holder tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Too full and on off, Holder flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a hard length, on off, Hosein fends it to short covers.
On a length and outside off, Hosein looks to play at it but misses.

Some extra bounce, on off, Holder turns it to square leg for one.
Good length, shaping away, Hosein flicks it to square leg for one.
Wide! Bowls it down leg, Hosein offers no stroke.

Too full and on off, Hosein slaps it to covers for one again.
Bowls it on off, Holder flicks it to mid-wicket for one more.
Too full and on off, Hosein pushes it to long on for one more.
Bowls it on middle, Holder taps it to covers for one.

Too full and on off, Hosein flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.

Some turn and bounce, Cariah blocks it to mid off.
Too full and on off, Holder pushes it to mid off for one.
Flatter and on middle, Holder flicks it but finds the man at mid-wicket.
Lands it on off, Cariah drives it to covers for a single.

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls it on off, Holder eases it to vacant silly point for a quick single.

Drinks break! Despite having a solid start, West Indies have lost half their side with still 17 overs remaining in the innings. The onus is now on this experienced pair of Nicholas Pooran and Jason Holder to resurrect the innings. On the other hand, South Africa have clawed their way back into the game with a couple of quick wickets. They will be hoping that if they manage to break this stand, they can run through the tail of the visitors.
Lands it on off, Holder drives it to deep covers for a brace.
FOUR! Fine shot! Shorter and on middle, Holder picks it well and pulls it over mid-wicket as the ball races away from the fence.
Too full and on off, Holder slices it to covers. The fielder does well to stop it. Dot again.
Full and on off, Holder drives it to mid off. Dot.
A single as this is played towards mid on.
On a length and on off, Pooran eases it to covers.

Flatter one on leg, with some turn, Holder sets off for a reverse sweep but misses and gets rapped on his pads. A loud appeal and the finger goes up. Holder goes upstairs. The replay shows that it was missing leg and the onfield decision is reversed to NOT OUT!
Another single as this is played towards long off.
Flighted up, on middle, Holder pushes it to mid off for one.
Fuller and on off, this is defended towards mid off.
Lands it on off, Pooran drives it to covers for a single.

Too full, on off, Pooran knocks it to long on for a single.
Lands it on off, Pooran eases it to mid off.
SIX! All the way! Full and on off, Pooran moves forward and slogs it over deep mid-wicket as the ball sails into the stands.
Fuller one, on off, Holder flicks it to square leg for one.
Floated, full on middle and leg, Nicholas Pooran gets behind the line and blocks it out.
Short and turning in on leg, Jason Holder goes back and knocks it down to long on for a run.

Short and outside off, Nicholas Pooran cuts it late and gets it just wide of short third man for a single. Gerald Coetzee there puts in the dive but still ends up conceding a single.
Fired in full and outside off, Nicholas Pooran drives it along the ground to extra cover.
Short and on off, Nicholas Pooran punches it down to long on for a run.
Full this time and on off, Nicholas Pooran defends it down the wicket for a dot.

Short and on middle, Nicholas Pooran goes back and pushes it back to Bjorn Fortuin.
Fuller outside off, Jason Holder opens the bat face and drives it wide of point for a single.
Jason Holder walks out to bat.

Shorter on off, Rovman Powell is tempted by the flight and uses his feet to get to the pitch of the delivery. He isn't to pitch of the ball but still decides to have a swing. Pays the price as he misses it altogether and Ryan Rickelton behind the stumps does the rest.
Commentary.Howout: st Ryan Rickelton b Bjorn Fortuin

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and turning in on middle, Rovman Powell flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Full this time and on middle, Nicholas Pooran drives it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Short again and on off, Nicholas Pooran uses his feet and cuts it hard and past backward point for a boundary.
Short and quicker on middle, Nicholas Pooran punches it straight to extra cover.
Full and at the stumps, Nicholas Pooran can only push this one back to the bowler.
Fired in full on off, Nicholas Pooran digs this one out back to the bowler.
Keeps it full and on off, Nicholas Pooran pushes it down to long off for a single.
Full and on middle, Rovman Powell knocks it down to long on for a single to open his account.
Rovman Powell is the new batter in.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND GONE! Bjorn Fortuin gets the big fish! Tosses this one nicely, full outside off, Shai Hope shimmies down the track and tries to clear mid-wicket with his clip. He gets it from the bottom part of the bat and does not manage to get the required elevation. David Miller stationed there times his jump to perfection and grabs it safely with both hands. The centurion from the last game for West Indies departs and they are now 4 wickets down.
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b Bjorn Fortuin

Commentary.Commentary: Angled in full and on leg, Shai Hope clips it straight to mid-wicket.
Short and on leg, Nicholas Pooran turns this one wide of short fine leg for a run.
Flighted, full on off, Shai Hope gets forward and drives it to deep cover for a run.
Short and on off, Nicholas Pooran goes back and pushes it to right of the bowler but does not manage to beat the extra cover fielder.
Short and on off, Nicholas Pooran plays it along the ground to extra cover.
Full and on middle, Shai Hope pushes it to the right of the bowler. Aiden Markram dives to his right but parries it away from the mid-wicket fielder. The batters cross for a single.
WIDE! Short but way down the leg side, Shai Hope goes for the pull but does not connect. WIded.
Full and quicker at the stumps, Shannon Gabriel can only push it back to the bowler.
Slower and short on middle, Shai Hope punches it to extra cover for a dot.
Short and turning in on leg, Shai Hope pushes it to mid-wicket for a dot.
Aiden Markram brings himself into the attack.
SIX! BANG! Floated, full outside off, Nicholas Pooran gets down on one knee and does not miss out. Thumps this one well over long on for yet another maximum.
Full and at the stumps, Nicholas Pooran gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Short and around off, Shai Hope cuts it hard to deep point for another single.
Short and on leg, Nicholas Pooran stays back and nudges it to deep square leg for a run.
Slower and full on off, Shai Hope gets forward and drives it to deep point for a single.
Flighted, full on middle, Shai Hope pushes it to extra cover.

SIX! Just over! Banged in short on off, Nicholas Pooran gets surprised by the short delivery but still manages to go through with the pull shot. Times this one well and gets it just over the leaping Rassie van der Dussen at deep square leg for a maximum.
Back of a length around off by Lungi Ngidi, Shai Hope hangs back and runs it down to third man for one.
Cutter again on a fuller length, Nicholas Pooran drives it along the ground to deep cover for a run.
Shortish delivery on middle, Shai Hope goes for the pull but gets it from the inner part of the bat to fine leg for a single.
Slower and on a length on off, Shai Hope picks the change of pace and pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length and on leg, Nicholas Pooran works this one off the back foot to deep square leg for a run.

FOUR! Streaky but Shai Hope won't mind it! Gerald Coetzee bends his back and bowls it short on off, Shai Hope tries to pull this one off the front foot. Gets a top edge that flies over the keeper and races away to the fence.
Shorter in length and at the batter, Nicholas Pooran turns this one down to fine leg for another single.
Back of a length on off, Nicholas Pooran stays on the back foot and keeps it out on the off side.
WIDE! Sprays it full but too wide outside off, Nicholas Pooran lets it pass and the umpire signals a wide.
Full and outside off, Shai Hope slices this one to deep cover for a run.
Full and on leg, Nicholas Pooran clips it to deep square leg for a run.
Slower and into the wicket on off, Shai Hope tries to work it on the leg side but closes the bat face early. Gets a leading edge which falls way short of cover.

Short of a length on off by Lungi Ngidi, Nicholas Pooran hangs back and dabs this one to backward point.
Length delivery around off, Nicholas Pooran gets behind the line and defends it to point.

He plays it a little too early and gets an inside edge on it. The ball then trickles back onto the stumps. Lungi Ngidi is delighted and so he should be. Both set batters back in the hut for West Indies.
Short of a length on middle, Shai Hope gets on his toes and nudges this one towards backward square leg for a run.
On a good length and angling in on leg, Shai Hope tucks it off hips to fine leg and retains the strike.
Back of a length and wide outside off, Shai Hope frees his arms to slap this one but does not connect. Five dots in a row by Gerald Coetzee.
Banged in short and outside off by Gerald Coetzee, Shai Hope shapes to pull but withdraws his bat at the last moment.

Shortish delivery, outside off, Shai Hope slashes hard at the delivery but misses.
Short and wide outside off, it was there to be cut but Shai Hope opts not to offer a shot.
Too full and on off, this is blocked towards short mid-wicket.
FOUR! On a length, outside off, King picks it well and creams it through covers as the ball finds the fence. Excellent timing!
Slightly shorter and on off, pace off, Hope looks to play at it but gets an inside edge as the ball rolls towards fine leg. They cross.

Lands it outside off, Hope defends it solidly.
Lands it on off, King drives it to covers for a single.
Shai Hope comes in at number 4.

OUT! RUN OUT! Full and on off, Brooks pushes it to extra covers and runs for a single. King at the other end doesn't leave his crease as Brooks loses his balance in the middle. Aiden Markram is quick to pounce on it as he throws it towards Ryan Rickelton at the batters end who does the rest. The partnership is finally broken!
Full and on off, King flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Up, up and over! On a length and some extra bounce, King picks it well and pulls it over deep square leg as the ball sails into the stands.

Touch short, King punches it to covers for a single.

Short and on off, King miscues his pull back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Edgy! Bowls it outside off, shaping away, King looks to drive it but gets a thick outside edge as the ball races away from the third man fence. Fifty up for King!
Bowls it outside off, King defends it to point. Three dots now.
Slightly shorter again, King tucks it but finds the man at mid-wicket.
Touch short, on off, King blocks it to mid off.
Lands it on off, Brooks cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Slightly shorter, on off, King cuts it to the man at covers.
Full and on off, King miscues his drive back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Too full and on off, Kings gets low and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary!
On off, defended out.
Flatter and on off, this is punched towards covers for one.
On off, this is punched towards covers for one.

Drinks break! After being put in to bat, West Indies are off to a good start with Brandon King leading the charge for them. The two batters are doing a good job of setting the base for the rest of the batters to come. Like the last game, South Africa have been unable to start well with the ball. They have offered too many loose deliveries allowing the opposition batters to release the pressure.
Short, outside off, King cuts it to deep point for a single.
Back of a length again, King fends it to mid off.
Slightly shorter and on leg, King looks to play at it but gets rapped on his body.
Slightly shorter, outside off, Brooks hangs back and plays it late towards third man for one.
Good length, shaping away, King steers it to point for a single.
Touch fuller and on middle, King taps it to the man at mid off.
Gerald Coetzee comes on to bowl, replacing Marco Jansen.
Lands it on off, King knocks it to mid on for one.
Full and on off, King flicks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Tossed up, on top of off, King cuts it to deep covers for a brace.
Another one on off, Brooks turns it to square leg for one again.
Flighted up, on off, King works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter one, on leg, this is flicked towards square leg for none.
Slower one, outside off, Brooks looks to drive it but misses.

On a length and on off, Brooks taps it to the man at covers.

Lands it on leg, Brooks looks to flick it but gets rapped on his pads. A loud appeal and the finger goes up after quite a while. Brooks goes upstairs to have a check. Ultra Edge shows no spike and Ball Tracking shows it was pitching outside leg. The decision is reversed to NOT OUT!
Good length, angling in, Brooks blocks it back again.
On a length and on middle, Brooks defends it back towards the bowler.
Wide! Lands it down the leg side, Brooks offers no stroke.
On a length, shaping away, Brooks drives it to the man at mid off.
Lands it on middle, King defends it back towards the bowler.

Lands it on off, King blocks it back.

A low full toss, down leg, King works it to square leg for one.
Bjorn Fortuin is introduced into the attack.

On a length and on off, King steers it to point for a single.
Slightly shorter, on off, King fends it back.

Some extra bounce, outside off, King looks to play at it but misses.
Time for Powerplay 2! South Africa can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the 30-yard circle until the 40th over.

Full and shaping in around off, Shamarh Brooks solidly taps this one towards extra cover for a dot.
FOUR! Wayne Parnell goes full, searching for swing, wide outside off, Shamarh Brooks slightly opens the face of his bat and drives it past cover for yet another boundary.
WIDE! Strays down the leg side, back of a length, Shamarh Brooks gets inside the line to tickle it fine but misses.
Length delivery angling away outside off, Brandon King opens the bat face and runs it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully timed! Fuller this time and on off, Brandon King picks the length early and drives it firmly back past the bowler for a boundary.
Leg bye! Full and shaping in on leg, Shamarh Brooks misses the clip but gets rapped on the front pad. The ball rolls to square leg for a run.
On a good length and outside off, Shamarh Brooks pushes it wide of mid off and calls his partner for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Fraction short and outside off, Shamarh Brooks hangs back and cuts this one past backward point for his first boundary.
Low full toss at the pads, Brandon King clips it to deep square leg for a run.

Back of a length this time and tailing in on leg, Brandon King misses the flick and gets rapped on the thigh pad.
Full and outside off, Brandon King looks to push away from the body but gets an inside edge that rolls straight to short fine leg.
FOUR! Fuller and angling across outside off, Brandon King throws his hands at the ball and slashes. Gets it from the outer part but wide of third man for a boundary.
Good-length delivery in the channel outside off, Brandon King watchfully defends it to point for a dot.
Shortish delivery outside off, Brandon King stays back to cut but does not connect.
Full and outside off by Wayne Parnell, Brandon King gets forward and looks to drive past mid off but mishits it to mid-wicket.
Shamarh Brooks walks in.

Skies this one high in the air towards mid on. Lungi Ngidi stationed there runs backwards and stretches his hands out to hang onto it. Marco Jansen strikes in his first over and delivers for South Africa.

Full and honing in at the stumps, Kyle Mayers blocks this one out down the wicket.
Fullish delivery on leg, Kyle Mayers tries to clip this one but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg.
Starts his spell with a full delivery, wide outside off, Brandon King reaches out to the delivery and gets a thickish outside edge that rolls down to third man for a run. .
A maiden from Wayne Parnell! Good-length delivery at the stumps, Kyle Mayers can only block this one down the wicket.
Full and angling in on off, Kyle Mayers gets across and tries to clip it on the leg side but misses and gets rapped high on the front pad.
Beaten! Pitches this one full and around off, the ball moves away and beats Kyle Mayers on the outside edge as he tried to defend.
On a good length on off, Kyle Mayers keeps this one out on the leg side.
Fuller this time and outside off, Kyle Mayers whips it along the ground but Tony de Zorzi at mid-wicket dives to his left to keep it to a dot.
Still some shape away outside off on a length, Kyle Mayers pushes at the delivery and luckily for him, he does not edge this one .
Full and on middle and leg, Brandon King clips it nicely but does not manage to beat mid-wicket.
Much fuller and at the stumps, Brandon King solidly gets behind the line and keeps it out.
Good-length delivery around off and angling in, Brandon King hangs back to block but gets it from the inner part and goes onto the pads.
Fullish delivery and outside off, Kyle Mayers leans and slices it down to third man for a run.
SIX! BANG! Lungi Ngidi goes short this time and outside off, it sits up nicely for the batter, Kyle Mayers swivels in his crease and pulls it well over deep square leg for a biggie.
FOUR! Length delivery around off, Kyle Mayers gets into a good position and lofts it back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Fuller this time and outside off, Brandon King is tempted by the width and goes for the drive but does not connect.
Back of a length again and angling across on off, Brandon King defends but gets an outside edge. He went with soft hands and hence the edge does not carry to wide first slip.
Back of a length and angling in on leg, Brandon King looks to clip but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
FOUR! Classy! Full and at the stumps, Brandon King picks the length early and presents a full face of the bat. Drives it back past the bowler for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Kyle Mayers stays back and runs it down to third man for a run.

A loud shout for LBW but turned down! Fuller this time and on middle, Kyle Mayers goes for the drive but gets an inside edge onto his pad. Wayne Parnell appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Aiden Markram isn't convinced enough and they opt not to review.
Wayne Parnell to continue...

Brilliant review from Brandon King! Lungi Ngidi bowls this one on a good length on middle, the ball jags back in sharply after pitching. Brandon King stays back to defend but does not account for the sharp inward movement. The ball catches him on the back leg and in front of the stumps. South Africa go up in unison and the umpire raises the finger. Brandon King is convinced and he goes for the review. The UltraEdge shows no bat but it is missing the stumps on Ball Tracking. Brandon King survives as the on-field decision is overturned.
FOUR! Goes searching for swing and bowls it full and wide outside off, Brandon King gets the width he needs and thrashes this one over point for a boundary.
Beauty! Lungi Ngidi pitches this one on a good length in the channel outside off, Brandon King gets forward to defend but gets beaten by the away movement.
Leg bye! Back of a length this time and tailing in on leg, Kyle Mayers looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh. The ball rolls behind square on the leg side and batters cross.
Lands it on a length and shaping away, just outside off, Brandon King steers it down to third man for a run.
Back of a length and angling in on leg, Kyle Mayers turns this one down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Strays onto the pads on a length, Brandon King rolls his wrists and glances it through square leg for his third boundary.
Full and drifting in on leg, Brandon King pushes with a straight bat to mid on.

Kyle Mayers is underway! Pitches it full and outside off, Kyle Mayers gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it through extra cover. There is a yes-no situation in the middle for the second run, Wayne Parnell collects the throw and hits at the non-striker's end but Kyle Mayers is safely in.
Serves it fuller in length and going away outside off, Kyle Mayers gets forward and lets it be.
WIDE! Another loose delivery, this time swinging way outside off, Kyle Mayers slashes but misses.
WIDE! Loses his radar and sprays it down the leg side, Kyle Mayers lets the ball pass and the umpire signals a wide.
Bowls it on a length on off, Kyle Mayers taps this one to mid-wicket for a dot.
Begins on a good-length and moving away outside off, Kyle Mayers covers his off stump and leaves the ball alone.
Wayne Parnell to share the attack.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Brandon King! Lands it full and wide outside off, Brandon King throws his hands at the ball and carves it over point for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Brandon King and West Indies are underway! Length delivery around off by Lungi Ngidi, Brandon King stands tall and drives it on the up. Gets it through extra cover for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, Brandon King does not chase the delivery and lets it pass.
Much fuller this time and straighter as well, just outside off, Brandon King looks to drive down the ground but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Keeps it on a good length in the channel outside off, Brandon King lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Starts with a good-length delivery, shaping away outside off, Brandon King shoulders arms and leaves the ball alone.

We are all set for the game to begin.  Both sides have lined up for their respective national anthems. First, it is the national anthem of the West Indies, followed by the national anthem of South Africa. The players take their respective positions on the field. Kyle Mayers and Brandon King will start for the West Indies. Lungi Ngidi comes to bowl. Here we go...

Shai Hope, the skipper of West Indies, starts by informing that they are going with the same team as the last game. Adds that they wanted to bat first anyway since runs on the board are important. Feels that they need to build partnerships during the middle overs. Shares that it is good to have confidence in the side and hopes that they can get over the line in this game. Ends by saying that he is enjoying captaining the side.

Aiden Markram, the stand-in skipper of South Africa, says that they will bowl first. Adds that there is a bit of grass so it will be good to bat second. He mentions the four changes and says that they will look to level the series. Ends by saying that they will give their best and win this game.

West Indies (Unchanged Playing XI) - Kyle Mayers, Brandon King, Shamarh Brooks, Shai Hope (C/WK), Nicholas Pooran, Rovman Powell, Jason Holder, Odean Smith, Yannic Cariah, Akeal Hosein, Alzarri Joseph.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Ryan Rickelton (WK), Tony de Zorzi, Rassie van der Dussen, Aiden Markram (C) (In for Temba Bavuma), Heinrich Klaasen (In for Quinton de Kock), David Miller (In for Tristan Stubbs), Marco Jansen, Wayne Parnell (In for Tabraiz Shamsi), Bjorn Fortuin, Gerald Coetzee, Lungi Ngidi.
TOSS - The two captains are out in the middle. The coin toss lands in the favour of Aiden Markram and South Africa have opted to BOWL first.

We have some news coming in from the South African camp - Temba Bavuma has been ruled of the third ODI after he experienced discomfort in his hamstring. In his place, Aiden Markram will lead the hosts in this game.

On the other hand, West Indies began well with the bat and batters kept the scoreboard ticking. Shai Hope truly led from the front with an unbeaten century to help his side cross the 300-run mark. At one point in their target defence, it seemed like the match was slipping out of their hands, but they fought back and bundled out the opposition. Will the visitors manage to secure a series win? Or will we see the hosts end the series on level terms? Let’s find out. Toss and team news coming up shortly...

In the second ODI, South Africa could only bowl well in patches, and as a result, they were set a daunting total by West Indies. While chasing, they were off to a flying start but lost their way in the middle overs. Skipper Temba Bavuma stood strong with a solid century, but it was not enough to get his side over the line. The home fans will be hoping for an improved display from their team in their quest to avoid a series loss.

Hello and a warm welcome, ladies and gentlemen, to our coverage of the third and final ODI between South Africa and West Indies at Senwes Park in Potchefstroom. After the first ODI was washed out, West Indies emerged victorious in the second ODI, and they hold a 1-0 lead heading into this game. The visitors will be hoping to seal the series with a win in this game, whereas South Africa will look to bounce back and draw level in the series.
... MATCH DAY …

It is time for the final match of the ODI series of the West Indies tour of South Africa. The visitors have a 1-0 lead in the series as they produced a surprisingly solid performance in the 2nd ODI. The first ODI was washed off due to rain and now the Proteas will have to win the final match to avoid the embarrassment of losing an ODI series at home. The hosts were the favorites coming into this series as they had beaten England a few months back. They failed to deliver a good performance in the second game. They will look to produce some support to their skipper, Temba Bavuma, as he was the standout batter and scored 144 runs, and was ably supported by Quinton de Kock who just fell a few runs shy from scoring his half-century. The rest of their batting line-up failed and they will be hoping for a better performance in this final game. On the other hand, West Indies had a near-perfect game in the 2nd ODI. They scored 335 and won the game by 48 runs. Their skipper, Shai Hope, was the stand-out batter as he scored 128 runs and was the man of the match. He will be expecting the same performance from his side and win this series. Can he do it? Or will the hosts bounce back and level this series? Let's find out together.
